text: 让 AI 用得起，更用得好！
en: Make AI affordable and useful!

text: 让每个人，都有创造未来的机会。
en: Give everyone the opportunity to create the future.

text: 三十五年，Linux 让我们看见：开放协作，
en: For thirty-five years, Linux has shown us how open collaboration

text: 能够创造共同的基础。
en: can build a shared foundation.

text: 今天，Qwen、DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi 与混元，
en: Today, Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi and Hunyuan

text: 正打开更多创造的可能。
en: are opening up new possibilities for creation.

text: 开源，降低门槛。
en: Open source lowers barriers.

text: 开发者，放大创造！
en: Developers expand creativity!

text: 让技术，走进真实的生活。
en: Together, they bring technology into people's lives.

text: 把创造变成共享的数字公共品。
en: Turn creation into digital public goods.

text: 让开放的成果，经过维护与采用，成为真正的帮助。
en: Through maintenance and adoption, shared results become real help.

text: 让贡献被看见，让支持有依据！
en: Make contributions visible. Ground support in evidence!

text: 用数据与评价，让每一步行动经得起检验。
en: Use data and evaluation to test every action.

text: 让贡献带来成长，让投入支持创造。
en: Let contribution drive growth, and resources support creation.

text: 用数据与评价连接双轮，让每一次行动，
en: Connect both cycles through data and evaluation, so every action

text: 都推动下一次前进！
en: moves the next one forward!

text: 从 OpenDigger、OpenRank 到 OpenShare，
en: With OpenDigger, OpenRank and OpenShare as foundations,

text: 把愿景落到实践，用行动检验承诺。
en: our actions must put our commitments to the test.

text: 分享一个需要，贡献一个工具，开放一个场景。
en: Share a need. Contribute a tool. Offer a real-world setting.

text: 改变，就从我们开始！
en: Change begins with us!

text: 让技术成为机会，让创造惠及更多人。
en: Let technology create opportunity. Let creativity benefit more people.

text: 加入 X-lab AI。
en: Join X-lab AI.

text: 现在，就一起行动！
en: Together, let's act now!
